# unreal-asm test data

Part of the library (decision D-14): every codec and plugin is tested on the files here.

| Folder | Content | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `text/` | One Z80 source with Russian comments in CP866, KOI8-R, CP1251 and UTF-8, each with LF, CRLF and CR line ends; layout cases (byte-order mark, no final break, mixed ends, an invalid UTF-8 byte, empty lines, an empty file); `source.utf8.txt` = the expected decoded text | generated by `text/generate.py` (run it to regenerate; the files are committed) |
| `sjasmplus/` | `hello.asm` and `module.asm` use sjasmplus-only directives (`DEVICE`, `SAVESNA`, `MODULE`, `OUTPUT`, ...); `plain.asm` has none | written for these tests (sjasmplus syntax from its documentation) |
| `tasm/` | TASM sources of every version (hobeta): 2.0 (`T20SRC.$C`, type `C`), 3 (`PRINTHL`, `APEAR`), 4.0 / 4.4 (`000LOAD`, `CALLLOAD`, `TABLES_L`, `SGEN_ASM`), 4.12 (`EXAMPLES`, `SINUS`, `SNAKE`, `ODNO`); `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `000LOAD`, `CALLLOAD`: the [TASM 3.02 disk](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249303/TASM3_2.zip) image; `PRINTHL`, `APEAR`: [Legend of Kyrandia demo](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:168024/LegendOfKyrandiaDemo.trd.zip); `TABLES_L`, `SGEN_ASM`: General Sound ROM 1.04 sources (`GS104SRC.ZIP`, KLUG's BBS archive, [klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `EXAMPLES`, `SINUS`, `SNAKE`: [TASM 4.12](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249305/TASM_412.ZIP); `ODNO`: [sobdemo](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:298066/sobdemo.zip); `T20SRC`: typed into [TASM 2.0](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249301/TASM2_0.zip) running in unreal-ng and saved there (no 2.0 source exists elsewhere; research-tasm.md §2.1). Extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-tasm.md` |

| `tasm/T50SMPL`, `T50PROG`, `T55SMPL` (in `tasm/`) | TASM 5.0 beta and 5.5 beta sources (structural lines); `*.txt` = expected decoded text | typed into TASM 5.0 beta / 5.5 beta (XL Design, 1997) running in unreal-ng and saved there; no 5.x program was published, the files are the codec's own samples |

| `alasm/` | Ten ALASM sources (hobeta, type `H`) covering every version range the codec reports and the special cases of research-alasm.md §5; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `ZADACHA` from [ALASM 3.8c](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:406950/ALASM38c.zip) (`al38c_.scl`); `SCR4MAKE`, `128KDRV`, `fibo`, `SNAKE`, `BUILD+` from [ALASM 5.09](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249271/ALASM509.zip); `2Kolonki` from [ACE 1.02 sources](http://alonecoder.nedopc.com/zx/ACE102SRC.rar); `RECPIC` from The Link's working disk (`testdata/machines/pentagon1024sl/TheLink.trd` in unreal-ng); `AL442nfo` from [ALASM 4.42](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:408359/Alasm442.SCL); `AL444nfo` from [ALASM 4.44](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249270/ALASM444.ZIP). Extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta) |

| `zxasm/` | ZX-ASM / ZAsm sources of every version (hobeta; types `C`, `z`, `a`), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | from the program disks ([ZX-ASM 2.4](https://vtrd.in/system/ZXASM2_4.zip), [2.6](https://vtrd.in/system/ZASM2_6.zip), [3.10](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249317/ZASM_310.ZIP), [3.15](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249318/ZASM315.zip), [3.3 Final](https://vtrd.in/system/Z33_F9.zip), [4.20](https://vtrd.in/system/ZASM4_20.zip)) and from [Info Guide #10](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:426650/INFERN10.ZIP) and [EPV 1.1](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:250322/EPV_11.ZIP). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-zxasm.md` |

| `storm/` | STORM sources (hobeta, type `C`, start #C00B), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `STORM1_3__MAIN`, `STORM1_3__DPC` (STORM's own source) and `EMULTEST__EMUL` from the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `ZX-FOR72__PLASM` from [ZX Format #7](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:429289/ZX-FORM7.ZIP); `DEJAVU4__LDISCROL` from [Deja Vu #4](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:425744/DEJAVU4.ZIP); `GC131IGS__HMEM` from [Global Commander 1.31 GS](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:587330/GC131IGS.zip). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-storm.md` |

| `masm/` | MASM sources (hobeta, type `a`), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `MASM_SRC__LS2`, `__M1`, `__M2`: MASM 1.1's own source (`MASM_SRC.RAR`, KLUG BBS archive, [klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `typed-masmdemo__DM`, `typed-masm11__t1`, `typed-masm20__NONAME`, `typed-masm30__T3`: typed into the MASM 1.0 demo, [1.1](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM_11.ZIP), [2.0](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM2_0D.zip) and [3.0](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM30M.zip) running in unreal-ng and saved there (no 2.0 / 3.0 source exists elsewhere). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-masm.md` |

| `gens/` | GENS sources: five TR-DOS files (hobeta, names `<disk>__<file>`) and three GENS3 / GENS4 tape saves (`*.bin` = the data block); `*.txt` = the expected listing (number and text) | `WINDOW__WINDOW`, `HISOFT-C__64-A95`, `ZX_NET__ZX_NET1`, `PF212__BOOT.A` from the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `ISC11VRG__ISCOP.C` from [ISC11VRG.zip](https://vtrd.in/system/ISC11VRG.zip); `typed-gens3-P-PROBE`, `typed-gens4-P-PROBE4`: typed into [GENS3 / GENS4](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/8091) running in unreal-ng and saved with P; `crafted-gens3-P-PROBE1`: a crafted text loaded into GENS3 and saved by it. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-gens.md` |

| `zeus/` | ZEUS sources: ADS 2.0's (raw whole sectors, `*.bin`), ZEUS v7.E's help (hobeta, type `Z`), five tape data blocks and a typed probe (`*.bin`); `*.txt` = the expected listing (number and text) | `ADS20SRC__*` from `ADS20SRC.LZH` of the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `ZEUS72ZK__ZEUShelp` from [ZEUS72ZK.zip](https://vtrd.in/system/ZEUS72ZK.zip); `ZeusRoutines__*` from [ZeusRoutines.tzx.zip](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/pub/sinclair/utils/z/ZeusRoutines.tzx.zip) (ZXDB 19058); `typed-zeus1983-PROBE`: typed into [ZEUS 1983](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/9010) running in unreal-ng. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-zeus.md` |

| `xas/` | Every XAS source found (hobeta, type `X`, whole sectors: XAS ignores the length field), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `XAS505SE__XMACROS` from the [XAS 5.05SE disk](https://vtrd.in/system/XAS505SE.zip), `XAS7_447__Read_Me` from the [XAS 7.447 disk](https://vtrd.in/system/XAS7_447.ZIP), `XASCII__XASCII` from [XASCII](https://vtrd.in/system/XASCII.zip); `CCINTROS__*`, `OBERON#5__mandelbr`, `P#14VRZZ__*`, `SNG_2APP__DAINGY`, `XAS7_43C__Read_Me`, `ZXNAV1_3__*`, `ZXN__KERNEL`, `Zxf_04Ap__*` from the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `typed-in-xas7447__noname`: typed into XAS 7.447 running in unreal-ng and saved there. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-xas.md` |

| `symbols/sjasmplus/` | `labels.asm` and what sjasmplus 1.24 wrote for it: `labels.sym` (`--sym`), `labels.sld` (`--sld`), `labels.lst` (`--lst`); `labels-maps.asm` (the same source with `CSPECTMAP` and `LABELSLIST`) and its `labels.cspect.map`, `labels.unreal.l` | written for these tests; the outputs from `sjasmplus --sym=labels.sym --sld=labels.sld --lst=labels.lst labels.asm` and `sjasmplus labels-maps.asm` ([sjasmplus](https://github.com/z00m128/sjasmplus)) |

| `symbols/pasmo/` | `labels.asm` and what pasmo 0.5.5 wrote for it: `labels.symbol` (all names), `labels.pub` (`--public`) | written for these tests; the outputs from `pasmo labels.asm labels.bin labels.symbol` and `pasmo --public ...` ([pasmo](https://pasmo.speccy.org/)) |

| `symbols/z88dk/` | `labels.asm` and what z88dk 2.3's z80asm wrote for it: `labels.map` (`-m`), `labels.def` (`-g`), `labels.sym` (`-s`) | written for these tests; the outputs from `z88dk-z80asm -m -g -s -b labels.asm` ([z88dk](https://github.com/z88dk/z88dk)) |

| `symbols/ida/` | `labels.py`: what `ida-python` writes for the sjasmplus golden source's SLD; `labels-dump.idc`: the IDC dump IDA 9.2 wrote of a 64K Z80 database after running `labels.py` (the input file's path in its header replaced by the file name) | made with `symconv` and IDA Professional 9.2 (idat, headless) |

| `dialects/alasm-sjasmplus/` | `constructs.alasm.txt`: every ALASM construct the ALASM → sjasmplus conversion handles; `constructs.sjasmplus.asm`: its expected conversion; `constructs.bin`: the 67 bytes ALASM 5.09 built from it at `#6000` | written for these tests; `constructs.bin` read from the emulator's memory after ALASM 5.09 ([ALASM509_STS75.rar](http://alonecoder.nedopc.com/zx/ALASM509_STS75.rar)) assembled the source in unreal-ng. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-alasm-to-sjasmplus.md` |

| `dialects/thelink/` | The GSTUNNE4 unit of The Link (hobeta): the main source, `gsports` and `SAVEOBJ4` it includes, `torusr.p`, `dplan2r.p`, `thelinkm` it `INCBIN`s, and `TUNNELZX` / `TUNNELGS`, the objects ALASM built from it; `*.asm` = the expected sjasmplus conversion of the three sources | The Link's working disk (`testdata/machines/pentagon1024sl/TheLink.trd` in unreal-ng), extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta); the `*.asm` files are written by `unreal-asm-tests` with `UNREAL_ASM_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1` and checked by hand against sjasmplus + ALASM's objects |

| `dialects/gs104/` | The General Sound 1.04 ROM project (hobeta): `MAIN` and the 20 sources it includes (TASM 4.0), `STUFF`, `BPM`, `SGEN` it `INCBIN`s, and `GS.C`, the ROM TASM built (= unreal-ng's `data/rom/gs104.rom`) | `GS104SRC.TRD` in `GS104SRC.ZIP` from KLUG's BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)), extracted unchanged with whole sectors (the slack after `BPM` is in the ROM). The author allows free non-commercial use and modification with the sources available. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-tasm-to-sjasmplus.md` |

| `dialects/tasm50/` | `T50PROG.bin`: the 45 bytes TASM 5.0 beta built at `#7000` from `tasm/T50PROG.$A` | read from the emulator's memory after TASM 5.0 beta assembled it in unreal-ng |

| `dialects/tasm412/` | `SIN7.$A`: TASM 4.12's SINUS example with `ORG #7000` (clear of TASM's overlay at `#8000`); `SIN7.bin`: the 256 bytes TASM 4.12 built from it | SINUS from [TASM 4.12](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249305/TASM_412.ZIP); `SIN7.bin` read from the emulator's memory after TASM 4.12 assembled it in unreal-ng (`tools/unreal-asm/assemble-in-emulator.py tasm412`) |

Each new codec adds its folder with files produced by the real assembler and a README section saying how they were
made (source-formats.md §3 of the design).
